remarks: Welcome to this one-bedroom condo offering comfort, style, and exceptional convenience in one of Norwalk's most desirable locations. Ideally situated just minutes from the South Norwalk (SoNo) train station and major highways including I-95 and Route 7, this home is perfectly positioned for commuters and those with an on-the-go lifestyle. Inside, the unit features a bright open-concept living and dining area with charming French doors that open to a private balcony. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer, assigned off-street parking, and a recently renovated kitchen and bathroom featuring a brand-new shower. Thoughtfully furnished and well maintained, this condo offers a true turnkey rental opportunity in a prime Norwalk location. Enjoy close proximity to some of the area's top amenities, including The SoNo Collection, Wegmans, Costco, and a wide array of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options throughout downtown Norwalk and SoNo. Whether you're heading into the city, running errands, or meeting friends locally, everything you need is right nearby.
